Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a tax on primary plastics and plastic products manufacturers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to imposing an additional business and occupationtax on primary plastics and plastic product manufacturers; and addinga new chapter to Title 82 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that the production ofplastics worldwide consumes about two hundred seventy million metrictons of fossil fuel each year. This production represents asignificant source of greenhouse gas emissions. It is the purpose ofthis chapter to accomplish greenhouse gas reductions by reducing theamount of plastics and plastic products and increasing the amount ofcarbon stored in managed forests.

(1) In addition to any other taxes, there ishereby levied a plastics tax collected by the department from everyperson engaging within the business of primary plastics manufacturingor of primary plastic container manufacturing in this state; as to suchpersons the amount of the tax is equal to the value of the productsmanufactured, multiplied by the rate of .215 percent. p. 1 SB 5747 (2) "Primary" as used in "primary plastics manufacturing" and"primary plastic container manufacturing" for the purposes of thissection must be defined by rule by the department. (3) For the purposes of this section: (a) "Container" has the same meaning as provided in RCW 70.95F.010; (b) "Plastic" and "plastics" have the same meaning as "plastic" inRCW 70.95F.010; and (c) "Plastics manufacturing" and "plastic container manufacturing"means manufacturing industries within the following classificationsunder the North American industry classification system: 3252, 3261,3332, 3335, and 42.
Taxes collected under section 2 of this actmust be deposited in the climate protection forestry account forfinancial incentives for the forestry sector created in section 4 ofthis act.

The climate protection forestry account iscreated in the state treasury. All receipts from the tax applied toprimary plastics manufacturing or manufacturing plastic containersproducts paid under section 2 of this act must be deposited into theaccount. Moneys in the account may be spent only after appropriation.Expenditures from the account may be used only for reasonableadministrative costs to develop, implement, and enforce this chapter.Additionally, moneys from the account may only be expended for thepurpose of promoting emission reductions and carbon sequestration inforestry. The department of natural resources and the forest practicesboard must establish financial incentives for: (1) Forest landownersto maintain and actively manage their forest land using managementactivities, including but not limited to, thinning, fertilization,genetics, timber stand improvement, and fire management; (2) forestlandowners to continue the production of timber and/or wood products;and (3) using wood in building materials instead of the more intensivefossil fuel products such as concrete, plastic, and steel.
To the extent applicable, all of thedefinitions of chapter 82.04 RCW and all of the provisions of chapter82.32 RCW apply to the tax imposed in this chapter.
Sections 1 through 5 of this act constitutea new chapter in Title 82 RCW.
